embeds.title: ARTICLE X — TRADES AND TRADE DEADLINE
embeds.description:
Trades are unlimited and are not subject to league vote or veto. A trade is not reversible merely because it appears lopsided.

Commissioner intervention is limited to narrow circumstances such as collusion, prohibited outside consideration, clear misconduct, or a promptly reported and credible misclick/platform error.

**Tradeable assets**
• Rostered players
• Eligible draft picks
• Current-season FAAB

**Prohibited**
• Outside assets or cash consideration
• Loans or rentals
• Predetermined tradebacks
• Other off-platform consideration

The trade deadline is the **end of Week 20**. Trading reopens the **day after the Stanley Cup Final**.
